repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-voicea
repository.purpose: Internal plugin registered as webex.internal.voicea (required by the webex package and used by plugin-meetings). It is a factory: createChannel(llmChannel?) returns a VoiceaChannel per meeting, which borrows a caller-owned LLM data channel. A channel PUTs Locus controls to turn captions, transcription, and manual captions on and to set the spoken language; announces the client to the voicea service, requests caption languages, sends manual captions, and manages the transcription subchannel over the LLM channel; re-emits inbound relay events as voicea:* and aibridge:* events; and rebinds to another LLM channel while restoring captions. It stores nothing and owns no connection.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not connect, disconnect, or tear down the LLM channel inside this package.
negative_guidance.why: The caller owns it; createChannel's JSDoc says the channel does not take ownership.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not call channel methods on webex.internal.voicea.
negative_guidance.why: The plugin only creates channels; registerAndConnect and the other README methods on the plugin no longer exist.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not rename an EVENT_TRIGGERS value or change TURN_ON_CAPTION_STATUS without updating plugin-meetings.
negative_guidance.why: plugin-meetings listens to six of the events and compares caption status values.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not send a data-channel frame without the shared sequence number.
negative_guidance.why: Frames continue the data channel's numbering from the last inbound relay event.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change a status flag before the checks that can throw.
negative_guidance.why: toggleManualCaption already leaves its status stuck at sending when requireLLMChannel throws.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the method, event, or connection reference.
negative_guidance.why: Several of its claims differ from code; see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: The developer confirmed no coverage gate applies; the legacy Jest config sets no threshold.

high.expectation: Source and unit test evidence both support the change, and the behavior has a case in test/unit/spec.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, for example registration, the trackingId prefix, the turnOnCaptions body, or re-binding after deregisterEvents. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question. Stop and report the gap.
